name: Almwirtschaft Haiming
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy mountain hut in **Haiming** with fresh **Almkäse**, homemade butter, and a stunning view over the **Inntal**.
beschreibung: The Almwirtschaft Haiming in **Haiming** is a charming alpine hut nestled in the breathtaking **Tiroler** mountain scenery, offering pure, authentic alpine romance. Here, hikers and day-trippers enjoy a well-deserved break with stunning views of the surrounding peaks. The menu features hearty alpine specialties like homemade **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Almkäse** with bread, and refreshing **Buttermilch**—all prepared with products from the farm itself. The simple yet refined cuisine is the perfect reward after a hike. The sunny terrace invites you to linger, while the rustic interior provides warmth and coziness on cooler days. The Almwirtschaft Haiming is a slice of **Tiroler** alpine culture you simply must experience.
